title: Acceletate Sleeping Speed At Night
description: Replaces the instant sleep mechanic with time acceleration. Experience a smooth transition to morning instead of skipping the night instantly.
body:
Accelerate the Night, Don't Skip It
Tired of the abrupt black screen when you sleep in vanilla Minecraft? Do you wish you could just fast-forward through the night instead of skipping it entirely? This datapack changes the fundamental sleeping mechanic to provide a much more immersive experience.
How It Works
Instead of instantly setting the time to day when a player enters a bed, this datapack initiates a time acceleration sequence. The night will pass rapidly, allowing you to watch the stars move and the sun rise, all without the long wait of a standard Minecraft night.
Key Features
Smooth Time Acceleration: Experience a seamless transition from night to day. The world doesn't just "jump"; it flows naturally, just much faster.
Preserves Atmosphere: Keep the ambiance of the night while removing the downtime. Perfect for players who love the mood of the game but don't have hours to wait.
Vanilla Friendly: No mods required! This is a pure datapack that works seamlessly in vanilla survival, multiplayer servers, or modded environments.
Configurable (Optional): You can customize the speed of the time flow in the config file to suit your needs.
Installation
Download the datapack file.
Place it into your world's datapacks folder (world/datapacks/).
Run /reload in-game or restart your world.
Sleep in a bed and enjoy the view!
Compatibility
Compatible with Minecraft version [Insert Version, e.g., 1.20.x].
Works on both Singleplayer and Multiplayer.
Enjoy a better way to sleep! If you encounter any bugs, please report them on the issues tab.
